title: US Remote Work and Social Skills Survey, 2026
population: US workers who worked fully or mostly remotely over the past 12 months
weighting: Each respondent carries the vendor's stratification weight (field: weight). results/ shows unweighted counts and percentages plus weighted_pct.

not_published.reason: Open-ended text answers can contain identifying details.

questions.text: In one sentence: What's something you used to do at work easily that now feels surprisingly hard — and what (if anything) are you doing about it?
